text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through 
the Twinkle Series with my partner 
Umamusume would begin. The name of the 
girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Hello, this is Aston Machan. At long last, 
Machan's journey to becoming an 
ultra-super mascot begins.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Do you understand? Your eyes are my own 
exclusive camera lens.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
At all times, keep your autofocus on 
Chan-Mei. Please don't forget that 
feeling.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our challenge for the Twinkle 
Series with <chrname> began!
